name: Z-direction Supersampling
definition: A hardware-accelerated technique to reduce aliasing artifacts by increasing the number of sample slices per volume in the z-direction, interpolating additional sample slices between existing voxel slices.
summary: Z-direction Supersampling is a hardware-accelerated technique that reduces aliasing by interpolating additional sample slices between existing voxel slices along the z-axis, rather than distributing multiple rays per pixel.
